notes:
- Five first-run choices, without locking the door: A first launch can now choose the app layout, theme, motion feel, joke frequency and top-bar shortcuts in one skippable setup. Every choice remains available in Settings.
- A catalogue you can browse and open: Search waits for typing to settle and ignores stale replies, then lays results out as a three-column poster gallery with anime/manga, format, score and year. Tap any full card to open its in-app title page.
- The title page can change your list: When a title is already on your AniList, its Info page now offers a direct route to the full entry editor: choose any AniList status, edit progress, score and dates, or delete the entry. The same editor works when a title was opened from catalogue search.
- Your Home says hello in more than one way: Nova Home chooses from a larger set of greetings on each visit, with a short expressive transition instead of repeating the same opening line.
- Search and Tiers can live beside the top-bar profile: The optional catalogue and tier-list shortcuts now appear in both Nova and Classic top bars, alongside Settings and Profile. Their switches are in Settings > Library > Bottom bar and the shortcuts are included in first-run setup.
- Search stays put while you type: The catalogue keeps the results already on screen while the next answer is on the wire, and shows a small indicator in the field instead. The skeleton now has one animation clock rather than two.
- The interface preview shows the whole layout: Settings > Interface draws taller mini layouts with the shared bottom bar and tinted poster placeholders; first-run setup uses the same preview instead of two names.
- The greeting changes as one piece: Nova Home fades both greeting lines together, and the first composition no longer consumes a greeting before it is read.
- Ani-chan reacts to what the app just did: New joke moments for a title joining a list and a search settling with results, plus fifty new lines across the five tones.
- The bottom bar can float a little higher: Settings > Interface has a slider that lifts the main bar 0-24dp above the navigation inset, with the mini layouts moving live and every page keeping room for it.
